g.text: read, escape, CRC, and send blocks
asynchronous valid ZACK / advance acknowledged offset
valid ZACK [window remains full] / keep waiting
use new offset when ZRPOS supplied
ZACK or timeout [finish attempts remain] / resend
ZCRCG and ZCRCQ keep the ZDATA frame open.
ZRPOS supplies a new offset. ZNAK and timeout use the
last receiver-requested offset retained by send_file().
reopen ZDATA frame when ZCRCW closed it
Fatal protocol/local I/O errors and exhausted 10-attempt loops
leave this state machine as a failed file transfer.
